content.comment_body: Hello, Is there a way to use a [product_name] with a [version_no]? I'm searching for a simple solution to send alarm text messages from a [version_no]. Thank you.

I don't think it's possible without a [product_name]. The [product_name]'s communication options only allow connection to a [product_name] basis module. However, the [product_name] can communicate with a [version_no]. You can send two messages from the [version_no] by connecting two digital outputs to the two digital inputs of the [product_name].

Hi [user_name], As previously mentioned, you can only wire the two inputs of the [product_name] directly to a [version_no] for basic communication. If you need more alarm messages, you have two options: 1) Purchase a [product_name] base module. Set up a connection between the [product_name] base module and the [version_no] CPU, then read VM values from the base module to the [product_name]. 2) Alternatively, consider buying an LTE communications processor for the [version_no] CPU. This allows direct access to all CPU data and you can send SMS messages via the communications processor. The relevant article number is [article_no]. This solution is likely more expensive. [url]

analysis.insight_summary: Users want to send alarm SMS messages by integrating a [product_name] with a [version_no]. They find the [product_name] is intended for use with the [product_name] basis module and not directly compatible with the [version_no]. The discussion reveals only limited features are available when connecting these devices, leading users to consider alternative hardware and higher costs.
